hook: CM takes Telangana's drought ask to PM Modi; *365* mandals hit
hook_b: CM takes Telangana's drought ask to PM Modi; *365* mandals hit
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy met PM Modi in New Delhi on Nov 15 to seek financial help for drought relief, citing the El Niño rainfall deficit.

beats.what: The state declared 365 mandals in 31 of 33 districts drought-affected on Oct 27: 111 severe, 254 moderate.
beats.why: Telangana got 615.5 mm of rain from June 1 to Sep 30 against a normal 740.6 mm, a 17% deficit, with 18 of 33 districts in deficit.
beats.care: Farm incomes and rural livelihoods are hit; the Assembly had urged the Centre for a ₹20,000 crore package on Sep 18.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: He also invited the PM to the Telangana Global Investors Summit and to inaugurate the Khelo India competitions.

cards.q: Who should move first on drought relief?

qs: How much of the requested aid typically arrives, and how fast?
Which districts carry most of the 111 severe mandals?

facts.t: Kharif crop area fell from *139.28* to *126.06 lakh acres* this season.

viz.verdict: Nearly a third of drought mandals are severe

watch: Whether the Centre announces a package or sends a central team.
